input.free_text_description: This system is a job/recommendation platform that serves Candidate, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including user, book, employee, department. The platform provides capabilities for rest exception handler, book repository, employee. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include messaging functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage book records, so that I can track and organize book data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage employee records, so that I can track and organize employee data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage department records, so that I can track and organize department data effectively.
